name: Tank Blaster
tagline: Bored with scrolling? Start blasting! TankBlaster is a revolutionary Chrome extension that reimagines your browser
description: Bored with scrolling? Start blasting! TankBlaster is a revolutionary Chrome extension that reimagines your browser. With one click, the website you are viewing becomes a fully destructible combat zone. Key Experiences: The Web is Your Map: Every element on the page—headings, images, buttons—transforms into a breakable obstacle. Use your cannon to clear a path and build your own tactical advantage.
